name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, May 15, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Proclamation declaring May as Mental Health Awareness Month
b.
Certificate of Recognition - Kamille Parks, Planning Intern
c.
Certificates of Recognition - Anti-Gang Drug Free Poster Contest
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-o, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting and Regular meetings held on May 1, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
March Treasury & Investment Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Ord No. 798 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita amending Sections 11-1.15.02(B), 11-1.1.48.04(A), 11-1.66.03(C) to define, conditionally permit, and set parking standards for a brewery with tasting room within the CR-Commercial Retail Zone. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #7j
k.
Consideration and possible approval of Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services Agreement with Regional Government Services to provide Human Resources Services
ACTION: That the City Manager be authorized to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Professional Services Agreement with Regional Government Services for human resources services.
Item #7k
l.
Letter of Support South Bay Cities Council of Government Chair re: Issuance of RFP relative to Broadband
ACTION: That the Lomita City Council issue a letter of support to the South Bay Cities Council of Government (SBCCOG) Chair in support of the issuance of a request for proposal (RFP) to data transport providers with fiber infrastructure in the South Bay to provide pricing estimates to assemble a "backbone network" that will connect facilities in each city to an internet point of presence.
Item #7l
m.
Request for red curb on the east side of Pennsylvania Avenue south of 294th Street
ACTION: That the City Council approve the installation of 27 feet of red curb on the east side of Pennsylvania Avenue between the fire hydrant at the southeast corner of 249th Street and a point 27 feet southerly.
Item #7m
n.
Request for removal of red curb adjacent to the Orchard Trailer Park driveway located at 25344 Pennsylvania Avenue
ACTION: That the City Council approve the removal of 65 feet of red curb from the east side of Pennsylvania Avenue between point 371 feet and 436 feet north of the north curb line of 255th Street.
Item #7n
o.
Request for red curb across the street from the driveway at 25971 Appian Way
ACTION: That the City Council deny the request for red curb across the street from the driveway at 25971 Appian Way.
Item #7o
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING AN ENGINEER'S REPORT FOR LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 ANNUAL ASSESSMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2018-19
Presented by Interim Public Works Director Vander Neut
RES 2018-15 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving the Engineer's Report of the City Engineer for the City of Lomita's Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 charges for Fiscal Year 2018-19.
Mayor to open the hearing.
Item #8
9.
Recess to Closed Session - Commission Conference Room
a.
Any public comment on closed session agenda
CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS - pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6
City Designated Representative: Laura Kalty, Liebert Cassidy Whitmore
Employee Organization: Lomita City Employees Association
b.
Reconvene in open session for closed session announcement
10.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the next Regular Meeting to be held on June 5, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Dated this 11th day of May 2018
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
